prior_evidence.cause: configured model requires a newer Codex CLI

decision: Do not repeat a predictably incompatible smoke and do not upgrade automatically.
required_authorization: Jovi must authorize a controlled official Codex CLI/application upgrade. The upgrade scope must exclude OpenClaw configuration, OAuth, profiles, auth order, models, and Runtime changes.
after_authorization: Record the exact installed CLI version and update mechanism.
Run one ephemeral read-only smoke with full pre/post workspace manifests.
Only after its success, run one ephemeral workspace-write smoke that creates exactly reports/codex_cli_smoke.txt.
Regenerate CODEX_CLI_SMOKE.json and rerun the P0 prereview.
